python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Monthly net outlays for FY1981 in millions
values = [59099, 53969, 54216, 57198, 54608, 55619, 58486, 53095, 53698, 64216, 56838, 76875]

# Calculate population standard deviation
n = len(values)
mean = sum(values) / n
print(f"Mean: {mean}")

# Calculate population variance and standard deviation
squared_diffs = [(x - mean) ** 2 for x in values]
variance = sum(squared_diffs) / n
pop_std = math.sqrt(variance)

print(f"Population variance: {variance}")
print(f"Population standard deviation: {pop_std}")
print(f"Rounded to hundredths: {round(pop_std, 2)}")
EOF
